query:
UPDATE invoices
            SET wallet_address = $1,
                wallet_index = $2,
                expires_at = $3,
                payment_reference = $4,
                token_address = $5,
                token_decimals = $6,
                required_confirmations = $7,
                network_type = $8,
                chain_ref = $9,
                created_block = $10,
                updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
            WHERE id = $11
